labelling: Assigned from each task's own instruction.md and ground_truth.json. Labels slice results after the fact; they never select tasks into a condition, and every condition runs every task.

categories.identifier_lookup: Find a known identifier or literal string.
categories.syntactic_pattern: Find code matching a syntactic shape rather than a name.
categories.api_call_sites: Enumerate the call sites of an API.
categories.interface_implementations: Locate implementations behind an interface or trait.
categories.symbol_tracing: Trace a definition or its references across a call path.
categories.dependency_impact: Analyse dependency edges or the blast radius of a change.
categories.cross_file: Evidence is spread over several files in one repository.
categories.cross_repo: Evidence is spread over more than one repository.
categories.refactor_discovery: Enumerate every site a planned refactor must touch.
categories.framework_noise: Framework-heavy code where textual matches are noisy.
categories.dynamic_ambiguous: Dynamic or reflective code where syntax alone underdetermines the target.

coverage_gaps.identifier_lookup: Absent from the original slice: the disclosure gate that makes it leak-free removes exactly the tasks whose answer is one known identifier. Closed by the symbol-footprint-* tasks in benchmarks/technical_debt/, whose answer key is derived by a word-boundary text match -- the same class of tool as the lexical condition's primitive, which is a bias to state alongside any claim drawn from this cell.
coverage_gaps.syntactic_pattern: Only five tasks in the original slice, none of them defined purely by code shape. Supplemented by the shape-audit-* tasks, whose answer key is derived by a parser -- the same class of tool as the structural condition's primitive, the mirror image of the bias above.
